about_the_game:
You step into the role of a married man striving to keep the spark alive in his relationship while building a future and starting a family. Together with your wife, you explore new dimensions of intimacy and connection. But as life unfolds, unexpected challenges emerge—testing your loyalty, your desires, and the strength of your bond.

Throughout your journey, you’ll encounter a variety of characters—from colleagues and neighbors to casual acquaintances—each bringing new temptations, tensions, or insights. Will you stay true to your vows? Will you stray? Will your actions bring you closer to your wife, or drive a wedge between you? In this story, sex can be a source of conflict—or a path to deeper understanding.

This is a choice-driven visual novel where every decision shapes the narrative and influences how others respond to you—especially your wife. Choose wisely, because your actions carry weight.

Enjoy the journey of trust and mystery!

content_descriptors.notes:
This is an adult visual novel intended for mature audiences. It contains explicit, consensual sexual activity between the main character, his wife, and other acquaintances. Sexual acts include oral sex and vaginal sex.

The game also includes a few depictions of war, which some players may find sensitive.
